verdicts.reason: 安装 v1→unit active/binary SHA=A1；重复安装幂等（SHA/单 unit/无多余 Execution）；升级 v1→v2 后 binary SHA=A2、config/args=v2、node state 2.0 healthy；备份内容 SHA == v1 artifact SHA（保留 Previous）；Agent 重启后 binary/unit/registry/journal 全存活；Desired==Actual。
limitations: Deployment-journal from_version is written from the synced Application definition at deploy time, not from the previously installed version: the v1->v2 upgrade row shows from_version=to_version=2.0. The previously installed version is instead proven by the pre-deploy binary SHA (A1) and by the backup content SHA == A1. Recorded as a product observation, not a case failure.
An explicit re-deploy rewrites the binary byte-identically (mtime changes); idempotency was therefore measured as "identical content SHA, single unit, no extra journal/Execution", not as "no write".

No browser UI was driven for this batch; caller-side feedback is the Hub API (POST /api/applications/{id}/deploy response, GET /api/executions/{id}, GET /api/applications/{id}/state). The Applications/Executions UI for this feature is already covered by the reused SYS-44 evidence (managed-app-ui.json).

The PREPARING-phase crash recovery mentioned in the batch plan (P0-002 attempt03) was not re-executed for AR-27; crash recovery is instead exercised end-to-end in AR-29 (rollback after a crash in VERIFYING). The previously recorded PREPARING evidence remains available for Root review.

verdicts.reason: journal 时序 VERIFYING(v3 SHA, unit inactive) → ROLLING_BACK(v2 SHA/config v2/unit v2/active) → DONE；Execution FAILED health check failed；node state unhealthy/3.0/error；无伪 healthy；v3 binary 无残留。
limitations: The product records a successful rollback as ROLLING_BACK -> DONE in the deployment journal (PRODUCT.md §42 lists PREPARING/STOPPED/REPLACED/STARTED/VERIFYING/DONE/ROLLING_BACK). There is no distinct "ROLLBACK_SUCCESS" journal phase to assert; the success verdict is carried by the Execution result (FAILED + block_reason) plus the restored-and-healthy v2 state, and the Agent's deploy result sets rollback=true (visible only in the Hub process log, not exposed through the API).
ROLLING_BACK lasted ~1s and was captured by ~0.5s journal sampling; the ordering proof does not depend on catching it (the binary SHA flips from v3 to v2 between the VERIFYING and final samples).

The health failure is induced by an owned artifact whose binary exits immediately, so the unit never becomes active; TCP/HTTP/COMMAND health-check failure modes were not each exercised in this batch (only the systemd type).

verdicts.reason: 同一回滚事件 + 恢复：定义回 v2 → Execution SUCCESS，Hub revision/version/artifact == Agent 本地定义 == 磁盘 SHA == node state 2.0 healthy；恢复后重复部署幂等；重启持久化。
limitations: Recovery required restoring the Hub Application definition (v3.0 -> v2.0): the product does not revert the Hub-side definition after a rolled-back upgrade, so Desired State (definition) and actual state only converge after the explicit definition update or a successful re-deploy. Reported as an observation; the case dimension "after recovery Desired State == actual state" is satisfied by the v2.0 restore.
The health check type exercised is systemd; TCP/HTTP/COMMAND failure paths are not covered in this batch.

verdicts.reason: 升级 v4 在 VERIFYING 期间 SIGKILL owned child（v4 binary 已落盘、journal=VERIFYING、Hub Execution=PENDING）→ 重启后 recovering incomplete deployment phase=VERIFYING → journal ROLLING_BACK→DONE，binary 恢复 v2、unit active、registry 不变；被中断 Execution 终态 FAILED/agent_restarted（无悬挂行）；其后 2 次 v2 部署 SUCCESS 且幂等。
limitations: The crash is a harness SIGKILL of the owned child Agent process (a real process death, no product source change); Product-internal panics are not simulated.

The recovery rollback re-runs the health check taken from the synced v4.0 definition (systemd) and the restored v2 unit satisfies it on the first attempt, so the rollback's re-verify step is real but did not need to wait.

Convergence of Desired State with actual state again required restoring the Hub definition to v2.0 (see AR-28 note); the journal DONE after recovery proves the deployment transaction is not left half-open.

verdicts.reason: 三种真实内核错误均明确失败且无半替换：备份目录不可创建 mkdir file exists；权限不足(chattr +i) operation not permitted；磁盘不足(128KiB tmpfs + 1MiB 备份) no space left on device。正向对照：目录真正缺失时产品自动创建并 SUCCESS。
limitations: The three seams are harness-side (owned path only, released immediately after each scenario): chattr +i immutable directory for the permission-denied mode (the Agent runs as root, so mode-based denial is not applicable) and a 128 KiB tmpfs mount for the disk-full mode; both produce real kernel errors (EPERM / ENOSPC) inside the untouched product backup code path.

"Backup 缺失" is covered as "backup destination present but unusable/not creatable"; a directory that is genuinely absent is created by the product (positive control above). The product's separate "source file absent" semantics (backup sentinel "absent:") was not the target of this case.

The deployment journal records PREPARING -> DONE even for a prepare-stage failure (a verify-absent sentinel); the failure verdict is carried by the Execution (FAILED) and the Application node state (unhealthy + error). Recorded as an observation, not a case failure.
When the backup write fails mid-way a partial backup file remains in the backup directory (observed in the tmpfs scenario and removed with the tmpfs); no application host file was modified.
